reload_sentence_embedder: reload a pretrained SentenceEmbedder model from a checkpoint path and params
create_sentence_embedder: create a SentenceEmbedder instance wrapping a TransformerModel with dictionary and pretrain params
get_embeddings: get single-vector sentence representations from input tensors using the transformer model
get_parameters: get trainable parameters for a specified range of transformer layers by layer_range string
set_eval_mode: set the SentenceEmbedder model to evaluation mode for inference
